title: fix: unify authorization and key editor UI
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Unified the authorization and key editors around shared Settings/Limits and Permissions sections, with consistent spacing, wording and icons across six screens. Generate is the master permission switch; category selections are restored, keyboard focus is preserved, and permission chips align on mobile. Earnings tooltips now use reader-specific wording, help stays beside wrapping text, and checkbox gaps remain clickable. Consent icons are neutral, while app-key editor icons are blue. This is a UI change; the app-access editor’s earnings disclosure remains deferred because its data lacks the linked app’s earnings setting.
